messages:
Evelyn R.: Heads up, received a case — employee had an obstetric ultrasound at a hospital-affiliated imaging center. EOB says denied as out-of-network and cites CPT 76536 billed as surgical/ambulatory facility code. Provider billed under facility TIN. Need short playbook for member and quick templates to send.
Diego H.: Common mess. First, request itemized bill + imaging report + facility billing NPI/TIN. Ask provider to rebill as a professional/physician claim under the physician NPI (not facility) and tag as "Corrected/Adjusted Claim".
Maya T.: Also confirm whether the service was scheduled or part of an episode from an in-network OB visit; that affects rules. If it was ordered by an in-network physician, include that order in docs.
Evelyn R.: Member is worried about collections. What do we tell them while this is open?
Kara P.: Send them a quick "do not pay" note and proof of active coverage. Use our temporary coverage letter + digital ID screenshot. Tell them to forward any collection notices immediately.
benefits-bot: Automated: Typical reprocessing after corrected claim submission: 14-45 days. Standard insurer appeal window: up to 30 calendar days. For urgent clinical re-evaluation, insurers may respond within 72 hours if labeled urgent. See internal guide: https://insurer.example/appeals-guide
Diego H.: Provider email template (paste):```Hello billing team, Please re-submit claim for patient [Name], DOS [MM/DD/YYYY] under the interpreting physician's NPI (NPI: [#########]) and indicate resubmission as "Corrected/Adjusted Claim". The original claim was submitted under facility TIN which resulted in an out-of-network denial. Attached: member EOB, itemized bill, imaging report, and physician order. Please confirm the corrected claim submission number and estimated processing time. Thank you, People Ops (benefits@redwood.com)```
Maya T.: Insurer appeal template if provider won't rebill:```To: appeals@[insurer].com Subject: Appeal - Reconsideration request for denied imaging claim [claim#] Member: [Name], DOB [MM/DD/YYYY] The claim was denied due to billing under facility TIN. Service was ordered by an in-network OB provider and performed by an in-network interpreting physician (NPI: [#####]). Attached: itemized bill, imaging report, physician order, and EOB. Please reprocess under the professional claim line. Contact: benefits@redwood.com```
Evelyn R.: I sent the billing template to imagingbilling@oakridgeimaging.com and the member the temporary coverage letter. Member last4 6789, member ID ends with B210.
Kara P.: I've added case to tracker (case #BEN-2026-491) and queued the temp letter. If provider delays, we'll open a broker escalation at day 7.
Diego H.: Also ask provider to reference the original claim number on the corrected claim; that speeds matching. If insurer insists it was facility-only, escalate to broker and include imaging report showing interpreting physician NPI.
benefits-bot: Automated reminder: State surprise billing protections may apply if the service was ancillary to an in-network visit. If member receives balance bill, contact People Ops immediately to escalate.
Evelyn R.: Provider replied — they can rebill but need the physician NPI. Sent that over and requested they mark it as corrected. Will update once resub ID is provided.
Maya T.: Great. Tell employee not to pay and to upload any new bills to the case. We'll monitor EOBs.
Evelyn R.: Provider sent confirmation: corrected claim submitted, resubmission ID 770-442. Forwarded confirmation and imaging report to the employee. Closing initial follow-up, will watch for reprocessed EOB. :white_check_mark:
